Appendix 2
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Appendix 2] <Amended on September 30, 2025>
Persons subject to continuing training for environmental educators, training periods, etc. (related to Article 6(2))

1. Persons subject to continuing training and training periods: the persons and periods specified in the following items. However, a person subject to continuing training may postpone the training for up to 12 months where unavoidable circumstances prevent participation at the time specified in the relevant item, such as a stay abroad, hospitalization due to illness or injury, pregnancy, or childbirth. In such cases, the person shall submit documents proving the reason to the head of the National Environmental Education Center.
(a) A person who has obtained environmental educator qualification: one day every three years from the date on which the person starts engaging in the work;
(b) A person who has not engaged in the work after obtaining environmental educator qualification and subsequently returns to that work: one day every three years from the date of return.

2. Method of continuing training: continuing training shall, in principle, be provided in person, but may be replaced by distance education where necessary.

Notes
1. The time for receiving continuing training under subparagraph 1(a) and (b) means the calendar year in which three years have elapsed from the date on which the person, after obtaining the qualification, began or resumed the work.
2. Where a person subject to continuing training moves, during employment, to another institution subject to continuing-training requirements, the periods of work before and after the move shall be added together.
3. One day of training means seven hours.
